title: How Shazam hears a song

beats.say: In a noisy bar, your phone hears music and noise at once.
beats.label: Music plus noise

beats.say: First it draws a spectrogram: time across, pitch up.
beats.label: Time × pitch

beats.say: Then it keeps only the brightest peaks.
beats.label: Brightest peaks

beats.say: Each peak is paired with a few that follow.
beats.label: Pairs of peaks

beats.say: A pair becomes a tiny code: two pitches and the gap.
beats.label: f1 | f2 | gap

beats.say: The server finds songs with the same codes.
beats.label: Matching codes

beats.say: For the right song, matches fall on one straight line.
beats.label: One straight line
